Combine results of nb_val()

c.voipred_nb.Rd

Combines results of nb_val() for different models, computed on the same data, outcome, thresholds and prior (and horizon, cause and censoring), into one result with all their models, as if they had been given together to nb_val(). A result given with a name (e.g. c(Full = res1, res2)) is labelled with it (results with one model only). plot() and the value-of-information functions combine the results given to them in the same way.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'voipred_nb'
c(...)

Arguments

...

Results of nb_val().

Value

A result of nb_val() with the models of all the results, in order.

See also

nb_val()

Examples

df_val_binary <- gusto[5001:5500, ]
fit1 <- glm(day30 ~ age + Killip + sysbp + pulse, family = binomial,
            data = gusto[1:5000, ])
fit2 <- glm(day30 ~ age, family = binomial, data = gusto[1:5000, ])
z <- seq(0.01, 0.3, by = 0.01)
res1 <- nb_val(df_val_binary, fit1, "day30", thresholds = z)
res2 <- nb_val(df_val_binary, fit2, "day30", thresholds = z)
both <- c(Full = res1, `Age only` = res2)
both
